newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico to hand over land to peasants in SLP.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to hand over land to peasants in SLP.

text.p: The Mexican government and the state of San Luis Potosi will turn over 74,100 acres (30,000 hectares) of land to peasants in the Pujal-Coy region over the next two years, President Ernesto Zedillo said on Thursday.

"Thanks to the leadership of the state government and the organization and patience of the peasant organizations, a formula has been found to solve the lagging agrarian problem in the Pujol-Coy district," Zedillo told a gathering during a visit to San Luis Potosi.
Zedillo promised to turn over 24,700 acres (10,000 hectares) this year.
The Pujol-Coy region is the site of a massive irrigation project that was considered the largest in Latin America when it began in 1973. Two large dams were built on the Pujol and Coy rivers.
